records.title: Refresh Chromium browser installation and its CI cache
records.summary: The published Playwright browser registry adds a dedicated chromium-headless-shell artifact.
conditions: The CI image or browser cache retains only the old Chromium binaries and relies on the default headless executable.
actions: Refresh Playwright's managed Chromium installation using the exact installed Playwright CLI and update the CI cache key.
verification: Run the affected browser test using the same channel and mode as CI.

records.title: Use changed for updating only modified Playwright snapshots
records.summary: The source snapshot option type omits changed. The target supports it and reserves all for updating all snapshots.

actions: Use changed for that workflow and keep all for deliberate full regeneration.
verification: Run the update in a clean working tree and review which snapshots change.

records.title: Migrate Chrome extension tests away from backgroundPages
records.summary: The source method returns registered background pages. The target method returns an empty array and exposes serviceWorkers.
conditions: Extension tests use the deprecated backgroundPages collection or wait for the backgroundpage event.
actions: Use Manifest V3 service workers and update the test to wait for a serviceworker.
verification: Run the real extension tests under their supported Chromium configuration.

records.title: Replace the removed Chromium devtools option
records.summary: The target removes the devtools Boolean declaration and retains the launch args field.
conditions: A Chromium launch or launchOptions object sets devtools.
actions: Use the documented --auto-open-devtools-for-tabs flag in Chromium args when needed, and configure headed mode explicitly.
verification: Exercise the actual developer launch and keep the default CI mode independent.

records.title: Handle Playwright JUnit error and failure cases
records.summary: The target shipped reporter adds an error classification alongside failure.
conditions: A downstream task scans JUnit XML only for failure elements.
actions: Count both error and failure in the JUnit consumer and keep their distinct categories for diagnostics.
verification: Run a test failure and an infrastructure error through the real CI JUnit parser.

records.title: Migrate deprecated Playwright context video options
records.summary: The source declares videosPath; the target removes it and declares recordVideo.
conditions: A custom browser context passes videosPath or videoSize.
actions: Use recordVideo with dir and optional size. Close the context before consuming the artifact.
verification: Run a video-producing test and assert the artifact path and dimensions.

records.title: Make device screen emulation explicit
records.summary: The target test runner forwards the screen option into browser context configuration.
conditions: A test spreads a Playwright device descriptor and asserts screen dimensions or responsive behavior.
actions: Decide whether to keep the device's emulated screen or explicitly set screen to undefined. Recheck affected media queries.
verification: Run the relevant device projects and verify window.screen and responsive assertions in the intended browser.

records.title: Initialize fields that depend on constructor parameter properties
records.summary: Playwright test discovery accepts the old TypeScript class on the source, throws on the target, and succeeds with constructor initialization.
conditions: Tests use TypeScript define-style class fields and a field initializer reads a constructor parameter property.
actions: Initialize the dependent field inside the constructor body after the parameter property is assigned.
verification: Run test discovery and the owning suite under the project's real tsconfig.
